basics.name: Hanna Boychenko
basics.headline: Technical Project Manager | Program Manager | PMO
basics.summary: Technical project and program management leader with 13+ years in IT, including Web3, crypto, blockchain, and AI delivery experience. I coordinate distributed technical, product, design, compliance, and business teams, manage timelines, scope, risks, resources, and dependencies, and drive critical deliverables to completion. My 7 years of hands-on software engineering experience help me translate between business and engineering, validate requirements, and keep release plans realistic.

about.text: I have worked in two Web3 companies and participated in multiple Web3, crypto, digital asset, and AI initiatives. My Web2 development background helps me translate between technical and business contexts, define realistic requirements, inspect deliverables, and keep remote teams moving through complex dependencies.

facts.title: Industries
facts.text: Web3, Crypto, Blockchain, Digital Assets, AI, Finance, E-commerce

facts.title: Team scope
facts.text: Managed cross-functional delivery teams of up to 25 people across product, engineering, design, analytics, and business functions.

facts.title: Technical foundation
facts.text: Technical education and 7 years of Web2 software development experience before moving into project and product management.

achievements: Coordinate three concurrent technical workstreams across a seven-person team for a non-custodial Web3 infrastructure product.
Turn business goals and technical inputs into delivery plans, ownership maps, milestones, release readiness criteria, and executive-level status reporting.
Coordinate engineering, product, design, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance stakeholders across complex cross-team dependencies.
Build and maintain Grafana dashboards, charts, and visual reports for product and operational analytics, helping the team monitor trends and investigate changes in key indicators.
Use AI-assisted development to prototype internal services and analytics utilities alongside project delivery responsibilities.
Drive critical-path issues to resolution by clarifying decisions, escalating risks early, and following deliverables through release.

experience.company: Confidential Web3 & AI Software Development Company (NDA)
achievements: Coordinated approximately six concurrent client projects across different delivery stages in a Web3 and AI software outsourcing environment.
Managed cross-functional delivery teams of up to 25 people across multiple client engagements.
Standardized planning, status reporting, meeting follow-ups, and risk and dependency tracking across active workstreams.
Connected technical and business stakeholders, translated priorities into actionable plans, and surfaced delivery trade-offs early.
Balanced scope, timelines, resources, budgets, and cross-team dependencies while maintaining visibility for leadership.

experience.role: Project Management Officer | Product Manager | Presales Lead
achievements: Managed 4–5 concurrent T&M and fixed-price software projects with cross-functional teams of up to 14 people.
Structured delivery across multiple sub-teams and managed several Project Managers responsible for individual workstreams.
Combined PMO leadership, product discovery, and presales responsibilities within a single cross-functional role.
Handled planning, roadmaps, risks, resource allocation, budgets, delivery ceremonies, quality reviews, and one-on-one sessions with team members.
Led delivery and solution planning for 90+ RFPs across multiple domains, translating client requirements into realistic scopes, team structures, timelines, and delivery approaches.
Developed and modernized a complex clinical-trial management platform, contributing to a new architecture, delivering new features, and extending legacy functionality.
Delivered new product features for Roomi, a US rental and roommate-matching platform.
Contributed to the ground-up re-architecture and rebuild of Mobilehead, a multi-brand HR-tech platform for algorithm-driven job matching, and delivered new features across its web products.
Developed functionality for a German platform that automated the coordination of repair and renovation work across buildings and premises.
Worked across .NET and JavaScript environments, including React.js and Node.js.
Worked on .NET, JavaScript, and Go projects.
Designed application architecture and supported code organization.
Collaborated with Polotsk State University on development courses aimed at identifying strong students.
Taught software development courses with theory and lab work.
Coordinated first-year students and supported thesis project management and quality control.
Designed and developed a database for storing and organizing information about components used in 3D scanners.
Built an application that enabled users to query the database and maintain records for those components.
